opening.argument: The video presents Pi Coin’s Binance listing as confirmed, displaying a price of $33.13 and directing viewers to sign up and trade on the Binance exchange. That is not a neutral discussion: the speaker expressly says to “sign up and then start your trade,” turning the claimed listing into a trading solicitation. The displayed Binance page, however, visibly states that the coin is not listed on Binance for trade and service. This direct contradiction undermines the video’s central promotional claim and establishes that viewers are being encouraged to trade on the basis of a listing Binance itself disclaims.
